title: IL-4 acts on skin-derived dendritic cells to promote the T
abstract: Atopic dermatitis is characterized by scratching and a T We sought to determine whether non-T-cell-derived IL-4 acts on skin-derived DCs to promote the T DCs from dLNs of ovalbumin (OVA)-exposed skin were analyzed by flow cytometry and for their ability to polarize OVA-specific naive CD4 Scratching upregulated IL4 expression in human skin. Similarly, tape stripping caused rapid basophil-dependent upregulation of cutaneous Il4 expression in mouse skin. In vitro treatment of DCs from skin dLNs with IL-4 promoted their capacity to drive T Mechanical skin injury causes basophil-dependent upregulation of cutaneous IL-4.
